failure_point.statement: The CI path validated the JSON syntax of the schema document but did not execute that schema against Portable Case Pack instances.

mutation.primary_delta: For a public JSON-Schema-backed contract audit, insert authoritative schema-instance conformance on a known-valid fixture and bounded negative fixtures before trusting a handwritten semantic validator.
mutation.hypothesis: A schema-instance parity gate will detect published-contract/runtime mismatches earlier than the incumbent syntax-plus-semantic path without increasing critical false-ready or rejecting valid structurally conforming cases.

incumbent.behavior: Validate that the schema document is legal JSON, then rely on the handwritten semantic validator for runtime acceptance.

challenger.behavior: Validate the schema document, execute the authoritative schema against known-valid and bounded negative fixtures, then run the handwritten semantic validator for cross-field domain rules.

in: public contract audits with an authoritative Draft 2020-12 JSON Schema
out: private downstream source code or business evidence
automatic canary, merge, release, or deployment

non_regression_constraints: A known-valid structurally conforming Portable Case Pack remains accepted by structural validation.
Semantic-only failures remain owned by semantic or admission validators rather than being misclassified as structural schema failures.
No candidate evaluation may grant merge, release, deployment, or team_available authority.

rollback.trigger: Any critical false-ready, authority drift, private-to-public leakage, or valid-case regression attributable to the challenger.
rollback.action: Discard the session-local challenger and restore the incumbent verification path for the affected scope.
rollback.revalidation: Rerun the target, representative, hard, counterexample, and reserved critical evaluations before any later canary decision.
